rule: Every opening video opens with a game over, which leads to a loading screen with all the stats.
used_by: tools/skate-short/opening_stats.py, which looks for this file beside the video it checks, then in the repo

not_blocking: the hub screen, its affinity card and LEVEL UP badge
where in the clip the game over falls (noted past 'within' seconds)
no inventory frame clear of pop-ups
elements taken from another menu visit

flatlined.what: the game over title (it moves sideways, so the search is wide)

rotate.what: the ROTATE prompt under V's preview

cursor.what: the menu cursor, a small hollow square; it shows only on empty space

spec.what: the user's own crops that set the template, from 545R-Takedown-000
